meta.name: V4 Data Organization
meta.objective: Organize the current V4 data and result surfaces across paper-audit and native conceptual-study lanes, identify which conceptual setups are runnable now versus blocked on missing bundle/spec work, and leave the repo ready for a controlled next launch phase before broader provider expansion.

knownConstraints: Keep paper-audit launch state separate from native conceptual-study planning.
Do not expand provider families until the data surface is explicitly organized.
Semantic clustering remains unsupported for V4 evidence-set-backed runs.
unknowns: Whether the duplicate Gilardi universe/set rows should be cleaned immediately or only after a dedicated integrity pass.
Which native conceptual evidence universe should be the first GPT-4.1-only launch target.
notes: The V4 paper-audit matrix already exists and has completed launch plus GPT-4.1 rerun analysis.
The next requested move is not more literature-audit execution; it is organizing the current data and mapping the native conceptual lane.

objectiveModel.terminalObjective: Organize the current V4 data and result surfaces across paper-audit and native conceptual-study lanes, identify which conceptual setups are runnable now versus blocked on missing bundle/spec work, and leave the repo ready for a controlled next launch phase before broader provider expansion.
successCriteria: Export a repeatable machine-readable V4 inventory from live Convex plus local source/build artifacts.
Publish a human-readable V4 data organization document that separates paper-audit assets from native conceptual-study readiness.
Record the concrete runnable-now versus blocked-now conceptual surfaces.
Leave the repo with a clear next queue for GPT-4.1-only native conceptual work.
nonGoals: Do not launch new provider-family cohorts in this workspace.
Do not redefine the locked paper-audit V4 spec.
dependencyPolicy: Prefer inventory and integrity-audit surfaces over new execution work.
Only propose conceptual launches that fit current GPT-4.1 budget constraints.

capabilityTiers.label: inventory
capabilityTiers.description: Export and summarize the current live/local V4 study state.

capabilityTiers.label: readiness
capabilityTiers.description: Map runnable conceptual-study cells versus blocked bundle/spec work.

baselinePlan: Use the current live Convex catalog plus local _local/v4_sources and _local/v4_builds as the baseline inventory surface.
Treat the existing V4 launch workspace as the paper-audit baseline and fork native conceptual organization into this workspace.
searchRegimes: exploit the existing V4 launch outputs instead of expanding provider search
use cheap catalog audits before any more live runs
pruneRules: Do not open new provider or appendix branches until the inventory surface is explicit.
escalationRules: Escalate to a cleanup pass only if the inventory reveals real catalog anomalies that threaten the next launch step.
promotionRules: Promote this workspace to complete only once the repo has a repeatable inventory command and a concrete conceptual-study queue.

stopConditions: Stop only after the inventory artifacts exist and the next conceptual queue is explicit.

budget.provider_budget_policy: GPT-4.1 only for near-term conceptual launches
